```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
inv_logit <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

fit_re_meta <- function(yi, vi) {
  if (length(yi) < 2) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(
    metafor::rma(yi = yi, vi = vi, method = "REML"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
}

extract_meta_stats <- function(model) {
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(tibble(
      pooled = NA_real_,
      ci_lb = NA_real_,
      ci_ub = NA_real_,
      pi_lb = NA_real_,
      pi_ub = NA_real_,
      tau2 = NA_real_,
      i2 = NA_real_,
      q = NA_real_,
      q_p = NA_real_,
      k = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  pred <- metafor::predict.rma(model)

  tibble(
    pooled = unname(pred$pred),
    ci_lb = unname(pred$ci.lb),
    ci_ub = unname(pred$ci.ub),
    pi_lb = unname(pred$pi.lb),
    pi_ub = unname(pred$pi.ub),
    tau2 = unname(model$tau2),
    i2 = unname(model$I2),
    q = unname(model$QE),
    q_p = unname(model$QEp),
    k = unname(model$k)
  )
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), NA_character_, ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", formatC(p, digits = 3, format = "f")))
}

net_benefit_binary <- function(treat, outcome, pt, harm = 0) {
  treat <- as.integer(treat)
  outcome <- as.integer(outcome)

  keep <- !is.na(treat) & !is.na(outcome)
  treat <- treat[keep]
  outcome <- outcome[keep]

  n <- length(outcome)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)

  w <- pt / (1 - pt)
  tp <- sum(treat == 1 & outcome == 1)
  fp <- sum(treat == 1 & outcome == 0)

  (tp / n) - (fp / n) * w - harm
}

net_benefit_pathway <- function(referral, outcome, pt, tested = NULL, test_harm = 0) {
  referral <- as.integer(referral)
  outcome <- as.integer(outcome)

  if (is.null(tested)) {
    tested <- rep(0L, length(referral))
  }

  tested <- as.integer(tested)

  keep <- !is.na(referral) & !is.na(outcome) & !is.na(tested)
  referral <- referral[keep]
  outcome <- outcome[keep]
  tested <- tested[keep]

  n <- length(outcome)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)

  w <- pt / (1 - pt)
  tp <- sum(referral == 1 & outcome == 1)
  fp <- sum(referral == 1 & outcome == 0)
  testing_harm <- mean(tested == 1) * test_harm

  (tp / n) - (fp / n) * w - testing_harm
}

nb_screen_all <- function(outcome, pt) {
  outcome <- as.integer(outcome)
  outcome <- outcome[!is.na(outcome)]
  n <- length(outcome)
  if (n == 0) return(NA_real_)

  prev <- mean(outcome)
  w <- pt / (1 - pt)
  prev - (1 - prev) * w
}
```

df <- read_csv("Data/merged_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

cat("Analysis cohort N:", nrow(df), "\n")

# Variable Availability by Study

This table uses the merged analysis cohort and shows how many participants in each study
have the variables required to compute APRI and FIB-4.

```{r}
availability_tbl <- df %>%
  mutate(
    has_age = !is.na(age),
    has_ast = !is.na(ast),
    has_alt = !is.na(alt),
    has_platelets = !is.na(platelets),
    can_compute_apri = has_ast & has_platelets & platelets > 0,
    can_compute_fib4 = has_age & has_ast & has_alt & has_platelets & alt > 0 & platelets > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  summarise(
    n_analysis = n(),
    n_age = sum(has_age),
    n_ast = sum(has_ast),
    n_alt = sum(has_alt),
    n_platelets = sum(has_platelets),
    n_apri_available = sum(can_compute_apri),
    pct_apri_available = n_apri_available / n_analysis,
    n_fib4_available = sum(can_compute_fib4),
    pct_fib4_available = n_fib4_available / n_analysis,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    apri_available = paste0(n_apri_available, " (", percent(pct_apri_available, accuracy = 0.1), ")"),
    fib4_available = paste0(n_fib4_available, " (", percent(pct_fib4_available, accuracy = 0.1), ")")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_apri_available), desc(n_fib4_available), study)

write_csv(availability_tbl, "Results/Descriptives/APRI_FIB4_StudyAvailability.csv")

availability_tbl %>%
  select(
    study,
    n_analysis,
    n_age,
    n_ast,
    n_alt,
    n_platelets,
    apri_available,
    fib4_available
  ) %>%
  kable()
```

# Recompute APRI and FIB-4

The formulas below match the derivation used in the merge script.

```{r}
df_scores <- df %>%
  mutate(
    apri_recalc = case_when(
      !is.na(ast) & !is.na(platelets) & platelets > 0 ~ (ast / 40) / (platelets / 100),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    fib4_recalc = case_when(
      !is.na(age) & !is.na(ast) & !is.na(alt) & !is.na(platelets) & alt > 0 & platelets > 0 ~
        (age * ast) / (platelets * sqrt(alt)),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

score_check <- tibble(
  metric = c("APRI", "FIB-4"),
  n_available = c(sum(!is.na(df_scores$apri_recalc)), sum(!is.na(df_scores$fib4_recalc))),
  n_matching_existing = c(
    sum(abs(df_scores$apri_recalc - df_scores$apri) < 1e-8, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(abs(df_scores$fib4_recalc - df_scores$fib4) < 1e-8, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

score_check %>% kable()
```

# Positive Screen Prevalence at Requested Cutoffs

Positive screen is defined as score greater than or equal to the cutoff.

```{r}
summarise_positive_prevalence <- function(data, score_var, cutoffs, marker_name) {
  score_sym <- rlang::sym(score_var)

  bind_rows(lapply(cutoffs, function(cutoff) {
    by_study <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!score_sym)) %>%
      group_by(study) %>%
      summarise(
        marker = marker_name,
        cutoff = cutoff,
        denominator = n(),
        positive_n = sum((!!score_sym) >= cutoff),
        prevalence = positive_n / denominator,
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    overall <- data %>%
      filter(!is.na(!!score_sym)) %>%
      summarise(
        study = "Overall",
        marker = marker_name,
        cutoff = cutoff,
        denominator = n(),
        positive_n = sum((!!score_sym) >= cutoff),
        prevalence = positive_n / denominator
      )

    bind_rows(overall, by_study)
  })) %>%
    mutate(
      cutoff_label = paste0(">=", cutoff),
      prevalence_pct = percent(prevalence, accuracy = 0.1)
    )
}

apri_prev_tbl <- summarise_positive_prevalence(
  data = df_scores,
  score_var = "apri_recalc",
  cutoffs = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0),
  marker_name = "APRI"
)

fib4_prev_tbl <- summarise_positive_prevalence(
  data = df_scores,
  score_var = "fib4_recalc",
  cutoffs = c(1.45),
  marker_name = "FIB-4"
)

positive_prev_tbl <- bind_rows(apri_prev_tbl, fib4_prev_tbl) %>%
  arrange(marker, cutoff, study)

write_csv(apri_prev_tbl, "Results/Descriptives/APRI_PositiveScreenPrevalence.csv")
write_csv(fib4_prev_tbl, "Results/Descriptives/FIB4_PositiveScreenPrevalence.csv")
write_csv(positive_prev_tbl, "Results/Descriptives/APRI_FIB4_PositiveScreenPrevalence.csv")

positive_prev_tbl %>%
  select(marker, cutoff_label, study, denominator, positive_n, prevalence_pct) %>%
  kable()
```

# Clinical Pathway Decision Curve Analysis

This is the primary decision curve analysis for clinical pathways rather than standalone predictors.
This figure focuses only on age-gated biomarker pathways, shown separately for APRI and FIB-4.
Each panel has its own legend so the age-cutoff ordering is easier to read.

```{r}
threshold_grid <- seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01)

df_dca_pathways <- df_scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(fsm), !is.na(age), !is.na(apri_recalc), !is.na(fib4_recalc)) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_cirrhosis = if_else(fsm >= 12.5, 1, 0)
  )

n_pathway <- nrow(df_dca_pathways)

cat("Clinical pathway DCA cohort N:", n_pathway, "\n")

pathway_defs <- tibble(
  marker = c(
    "FibroScan pathways",
    "FibroScan pathways",
    "FibroScan pathways",
    "APRI pathways",
    "APRI pathways",
    "APRI pathways",
    "FIB-4 pathways",
    "FIB-4 pathways",
    "FIB-4 pathways"
  ),
  label = c(
    "Age > 35 then FibroScan",
    "Age > 40 then FibroScan",
    "Age > 45 then FibroScan",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0",
    "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45",
    "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45",
    "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45"
  ),
  referral = list(
    df_dca_pathways$age > 35,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 40,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 45,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 35 & df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= 1.0,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 40 & df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= 1.0,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 45 & df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= 1.0,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 35 & df_dca_pathways$fib4_recalc >= 1.45,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 40 & df_dca_pathways$fib4_recalc >= 1.45,
    df_dca_pathways$age > 45 & df_dca_pathways$fib4_recalc >= 1.45
  ),
  tested = list(
    rep(0L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
    rep(0L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
    rep(0L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
    as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > 35),
    as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > 40),
    as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > 45),
    as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > 35),
    as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > 40),
    as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > 45)
  )
)

if (nrow(df_dca_pathways) > 0) {
  pathway_dca_tbl <- tibble(threshold = threshold_grid) %>%
    group_by(threshold) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      pt <- .y$threshold[[1]]
      outcome <- df_dca_pathways$outcome_cirrhosis

      reference_rows <- tibble(
        marker = c(
          "FibroScan pathways",
          "FibroScan pathways",
          "APRI pathways",
          "APRI pathways",
          "FIB-4 pathways",
          "FIB-4 pathways"
        ),
        label = c(
          "Universal FibroScan",
          "Screen None",
          "Universal APRI >= 1.0",
          "Screen None",
          "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45",
          "Screen None"
        ),
        net_benefit = c(
          net_benefit_pathway(
            referral = rep(1L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
            outcome = outcome,
            pt = pt,
            tested = rep(0L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
            test_harm = 0
          ),
          0,
          net_benefit_pathway(
            referral = df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= 1.0,
            outcome = outcome,
            pt = pt,
            tested = rep(1L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
            test_harm = 0
          ),
          0,
          net_benefit_pathway(
            referral = df_dca_pathways$fib4_recalc >= 1.45,
            outcome = outcome,
            pt = pt,
            tested = rep(1L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)),
            test_harm = 0
          ),
          0
        )
      )

      strategy_rows <- pathway_defs %>%
        mutate(
          net_benefit = purrr::map2_dbl(
            referral,
            tested,
            ~ net_benefit_pathway(.x, outcome, pt, tested = .y, test_harm = 0)
          )
        ) %>%
        select(marker, label, net_benefit)

      bind_rows(reference_rows, strategy_rows)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      label = factor(
        label,
        levels = c(
          "Universal FibroScan",
          "Universal APRI >= 1.0",
          "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45",
          "Screen None",
          "Age > 35 then FibroScan",
          "Age > 40 then FibroScan",
          "Age > 45 then FibroScan",
          "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0",
          "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0",
          "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0",
          "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45",
          "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45",
          "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45"
        )
      )
    )

  write_csv(pathway_dca_tbl, "Results/DCA/DCA_Clinical_Pathways_Cirrhosis_Data.csv")

  fibroscan_palette <- c(
    "Universal FibroScan" = "black",
    "Screen None" = "black",
    "Age > 35 then FibroScan" = "#1b9e77",
    "Age > 40 then FibroScan" = "#66a61e",
    "Age > 45 then FibroScan" = "#a6d854"
  )

  apri_palette <- c(
    "Universal APRI >= 1.0" = "black",
    "Screen None" = "black",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#d95f02",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#fc8d62",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#fddbc7"
  )

  fib4_palette <- c(
    "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "black",
    "Screen None" = "black",
    "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#1f78b4",
    "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#74add1",
    "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#d1e5f0"
  )

  fibroscan_plot <- pathway_dca_tbl %>%
    filter(marker == "FibroScan pathways") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.1)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Universal FibroScan" = "solid",
        "Screen None" = "dotted",
        "Age > 35 then FibroScan" = "solid",
        "Age > 40 then FibroScan" = "solid",
        "Age > 45 then FibroScan" = "solid"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = fibroscan_palette) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Original FibroScan strategy (n = ", n_pathway, ")"),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )

  apri_plot <- pathway_dca_tbl %>%
    filter(marker == "APRI pathways") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.1)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Universal APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "Screen None" = "dotted",
        "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = apri_palette) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Age-gated two-step APRI strategy (n = ", n_pathway, ")"),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )

  fib4_plot <- pathway_dca_tbl %>%
    filter(marker == "FIB-4 pathways") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.1)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid",
        "Screen None" = "dotted",
        "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid",
        "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid",
        "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = fib4_palette) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Age-gated two-step FIB-4 strategy (n = ", n_pathway, ")"),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )

  combined_pathway_plot <- fibroscan_plot / apri_plot / fib4_plot

  ggsave("Results/DCA/DCA_Clinical_Pathways_Cirrhosis.png", combined_pathway_plot, width = 10, height = 18, dpi = 300)

  combined_single_panel_palette <- c(
    "Universal FibroScan" = "darkgreen",
    "Universal APRI >= 1.0" = "#b15928",
    "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#1f78b4",
    "Screen None" = "black",
    "Age > 35 then FibroScan" = "#1b9e77",
    "Age > 40 then FibroScan" = "#66a61e",
    "Age > 45 then FibroScan" = "#a6d854",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#d95f02",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#fc8d62",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#fddbc7",
    "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#1f78b4",
    "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#74add1",
    "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#d1e5f0"
  )

  combined_single_panel_linetypes <- c(
    "Universal FibroScan" = "dashed",
    "Universal APRI >= 1.0" = "dashed",
    "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "dashed",
    "Screen None" = "solid",
    "Age > 35 then FibroScan" = "solid",
    "Age > 40 then FibroScan" = "solid",
    "Age > 45 then FibroScan" = "solid",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
    "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid",
    "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid",
    "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid"
  )

  combined_single_panel_order <- c(
    "Universal FibroScan",
    "Universal APRI >= 1.0",
    "Universal FIB-4 >= 1.45",
    "Screen None",
    "Age > 35 then FibroScan",
    "Age > 40 then FibroScan",
    "Age > 45 then FibroScan",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0",
    "Age > 35 then FIB-4 >= 1.45",
    "Age > 40 then FIB-4 >= 1.45",
    "Age > 45 then FIB-4 >= 1.45"
  )

  pathway_dca_tbl_single_panel <- pathway_dca_tbl %>%
    mutate(label = factor(as.character(label), levels = combined_single_panel_order))

  write_csv(pathway_dca_tbl_single_panel, "Results/DCA/DCA_Clinical_Pathways_AllOnOne_Cirrhosis_Data.csv")

  combined_single_panel_plot <- pathway_dca_tbl_single_panel %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +

    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = combined_single_panel_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = combined_single_panel_linetypes, drop = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Combined clinical pathways (n = ", n_pathway, ")"),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )

  ggsave("Results/DCA/DCA_Clinical_Pathways_AllOnOne_Cirrhosis.png", combined_single_panel_plot, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)

  apri_cutoff_defs <- tidyr::crossing(
    cutoff = c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0),
    age_cutoff = c(35, 40, 45)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cutoff_label = formatC(cutoff, format = "f", digits = 1),
      panel = paste0("APRI >= ", cutoff_label),
      label = paste0("Age > ", age_cutoff, " then APRI >= ", cutoff_label),
      referral = purrr::map2(age_cutoff, cutoff, ~ df_dca_pathways$age > .x & df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= .y),
      tested = purrr::map(age_cutoff, ~ as.integer(df_dca_pathways$age > .x))
    )

  apri_cutoff_dca_tbl <- tibble(threshold = threshold_grid) %>%
    group_by(threshold) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      pt <- .y$threshold[[1]]
      outcome <- df_dca_pathways$outcome_cirrhosis

      reference_rows <- tibble(
        panel = rep(paste0("APRI >= ", formatC(c(0.5, 1.0, 2.0), format = "f", digits = 1)), each = 2),
        label = rep(c("Universal APRI", "Screen None"), times = 3),
        net_benefit = c(

          0,
          net_benefit_pathway(df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= 1.0, outcome, pt, tested = rep(1L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)), test_harm = 0),
          0,
          net_benefit_pathway(df_dca_pathways$apri_recalc >= 2.0, outcome, pt, tested = rep(1L, nrow(df_dca_pathways)), test_harm = 0),
          0
        )
      )

      strategy_rows <- apri_cutoff_defs %>%
        mutate(
          net_benefit = purrr::map2_dbl(
            referral,
            tested,
            ~ net_benefit_pathway(.x, outcome, pt, tested = .y, test_harm = 0)
          )
        ) %>%
        select(panel, label, net_benefit)

      bind_rows(reference_rows, strategy_rows)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      label = factor(
        label,
        levels = c(
          "Universal APRI",
          "Screen None",
          "Age > 35 then APRI >= 0.5",

          "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0",
          "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0",
          "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0",
          "Age > 35 then APRI >= 2.0",
          "Age > 40 then APRI >= 2.0",
          "Age > 45 then APRI >= 2.0"
        )
      ),
      panel = factor(panel, levels = c("APRI >= 0.5", "APRI >= 1.0", "APRI >= 2.0"))
    )

  write_csv(apri_cutoff_dca_tbl, "Results/DCA/DCA_APRI_CutoffPathways_Cirrhosis_Data.csv")

  apri_cutoff_palette <- c(
    "Universal APRI" = "black",
    "Screen None" = "black",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 0.5" = "#b35806",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 0.5" = "#e08214",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 0.5" = "#fdb863",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#d95f02",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#fc8d62",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0" = "#fddbc7",
    "Age > 35 then APRI >= 2.0" = "#7f3b08",
    "Age > 40 then APRI >= 2.0" = "#b35806",
    "Age > 45 then APRI >= 2.0" = "#e08214"
  )

  apri_cutoff_plot <- apri_cutoff_dca_tbl %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, ncol = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.025, 0.1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = apri_cutoff_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Universal APRI" = "dashed",
        "Screen None" = "solid",
        "Age > 35 then APRI >= 0.5" = "solid",
        "Age > 40 then APRI >= 0.5" = "solid",
        "Age > 45 then APRI >= 0.5" = "solid",
        "Age > 35 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 40 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 45 then APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 35 then APRI >= 2.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 40 then APRI >= 2.0" = "solid",
        "Age > 45 then APRI >= 2.0" = "solid"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Age-gated APRI pathways across cutoffs (n = ", n_pathway, ")"),
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )

  ggsave("Results/DCA/DCA_APRI_CutoffPathways_Cirrhosis.png", apri_cutoff_plot, width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)

  pathway_snapshot_tbl <- pathway_dca_tbl %>%
    filter(abs(threshold - 0.10) < 1e-9) %>%
    arrange(marker, desc(net_benefit))

  pathway_snapshot_tbl %>%
    kable(digits = 3)
} else {
  cat("Not enough biomarker-complete data for clinical pathway decision curve analysis.\n")
}
```

# Standalone Referral-rule Sensitivity Analyses

The sections below keep the one-step referral-rule DCAs for sensitivity only.
They compare standalone rules rather than full clinical pathways.

# Decision Curve Analysis Comparing Biomarkers

This decision curve analysis compares biomarker-based screen strategies for cirrhosis,
defined as FibroScan $\ge$ 12.5 kPa, using the matched subset with all biomarker values available.

```{r}
df_dca_biomarkers <- df_scores %>%
  filter(!is.na(fsm), !is.na(apri_recalc), !is.na(fib4_recalc)) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_cirrhosis = if_else(fsm >= 12.5, 1, 0),
    strategy_apri_0_5 = if_else(apri_recalc >= 0.5, 1, 0),
    strategy_apri_1_0 = if_else(apri_recalc >= 1.0, 1, 0),
    strategy_apri_2_0 = if_else(apri_recalc >= 2.0, 1, 0),
    strategy_fib4_1_45 = if_else(fib4_recalc >= 1.45, 1, 0)
  )

cat("Matched biomarker DCA cohort N:", nrow(df_dca_biomarkers), "\n")

if (nrow(df_dca_biomarkers) > 0) {
  dca_biomarker_result <- dca(
    formula = outcome_cirrhosis ~ strategy_apri_0_5 + strategy_apri_1_0 + strategy_apri_2_0 + strategy_fib4_1_45,
    data = df_dca_biomarkers,
    thresholds = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01),
    label = list(
      strategy_apri_0_5 = "APRI >= 0.5",
      strategy_apri_1_0 = "APRI >= 1.0",
      strategy_apri_2_0 = "APRI >= 2.0",
      strategy_fib4_1_45 = "FIB-4 >= 1.45"
    )
  )

  dca_biomarker_tbl <- dca_biomarker_result %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat All", "Screen All")) %>%
    mutate(label = str_replace(label, "Treat None", "Screen None"))

  write_csv(dca_biomarker_tbl, "Results/DCA/DCA_Biomarker_Strategies_Data.csv")

  dca_biomarker_tbl %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = threshold, y = net_benefit, color = label, linetype = label)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.3), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.01, NA)) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c(
        "Screen All" = "solid",
        "Screen None" = "dotted",
        "APRI >= 0.5" = "solid",
        "APRI >= 1.0" = "solid",
        "APRI >= 2.0" = "solid",
        "FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "solid"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Screen All" = "black",
        "Screen None" = "black",
        "APRI >= 0.5" = "#1b9e77",
        "APRI >= 1.0" = "#d95f02",
        "APRI >= 2.0" = "#7570b3",
        "FIB-4 >= 1.45" = "#e7298a"
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Decision Curve Analysis: Biomarker Strategies for Detecting Cirrhosis",
      x = "Threshold Probability",
      y = "Net Benefit",
      color = "Strategy",
      linetype = "Strategy"
    )

  ggsave("Results/DCA/DCA_Biomarker_Strategies_Cirrhosis.png", width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

  dca_biomarker_tbl %>%
    select(threshold, label, net_benefit) %>%
    kable(digits = 3)
} else {
  cat("Not enough matched biomarker data for decision curve analysis.\n")
}
```

# Meta-analysis of Positive Screen Prevalence

Random-effects meta-analysis is performed across contributing studies for each marker and cutoff
using a logit-transformed proportion.

```{r}
meta_input_tbl <- positive_prev_tbl %>%
  filter(study != "Overall")

run_prevalence_meta <- function(data) {
  esc <- metafor::escalc(
    measure = "PLO",
    xi = data$positive_n,
    ni = data$denominator,
    slab = data$study,
    add = 0.5,
    to = "only0"
  )

  model <- fit_re_meta(esc$yi, esc$vi)
  stats <- extract_meta_stats(model)

  tibble(
    marker = data$marker[[1]],
    cutoff = data$cutoff[[1]],
    cutoff_label = data$cutoff_label[[1]],
    studies = nrow(data),
    total_n = sum(data$denominator),
    total_positive = sum(data$positive_n),
    pooled_prevalence = inv_logit(stats$pooled),
    pooled_ci_lb = inv_logit(stats$ci_lb),
    pooled_ci_ub = inv_logit(stats$ci_ub),
    pooled_pi_lb = inv_logit(stats$pi_lb),
    pooled_pi_ub = inv_logit(stats$pi_ub),
    tau2 = stats$tau2,
    i2 = stats$i2,
    q = stats$q,
    q_p = stats$q_p,
    q_p_label = format_p(stats$q_p)
  )
}

meta_summary_tbl <- meta_input_tbl %>%
  group_by(marker, cutoff, cutoff_label) %>%
  group_modify(~ run_prevalence_meta(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pooled_prevalence_pct = percent(pooled_prevalence, accuracy = 0.1),
    pooled_ci = paste0(percent(pooled_ci_lb, accuracy = 0.1), " to ", percent(pooled_ci_ub, accuracy = 0.1)),
    pooled_pi = paste0(percent(pooled_pi_lb, accuracy = 0.1), " to ", percent(pooled_pi_ub, accuracy = 0.1)),
    i2_pct = percent(i2 / 100, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(marker, cutoff)

write_csv(meta_input_tbl, "Results/Metaanalysis/APRI_FIB4_PositiveScreen_MetaInput.csv")
write_csv(meta_summary_tbl, "Results/Metaanalysis/APRI_FIB4_PositiveScreen_MetaSummary.csv")

meta_summary_tbl %>%
  select(
    marker,
    cutoff_label,
    studies,
    total_n,
    total_positive,
    pooled_prevalence_pct,
    pooled_ci,
    pooled_pi,
    i2_pct,
    q_p_label
  ) %>%
  kable()
```
